description: HubVibe Agent (pro): hand it any task in plain words and get the finished result in one call. Research a company or a person of interest, check a website, screen a name, read the markets, compare options, pull the facts: you get a headline, the key points, the full answer, its sources and every tool step. Up to 10 steps. Charged only when the answer is delivered. Input: task; optional context, fields for a JSON answer, language. $9.00 per call. Returns: task, tier, headline, key_points[], answer, data, steps[{n,tool,input,ok,summary,seconds}], tools_used[], sources[], notes[].

context.description: Optional material the task refers to (text or JSON).

fields.description: Optional: also return `data` with exactly these keys.

language.description: Optional answer language, BCP-47 (en, ja, pt-BR). Default: the input's.

name: hubvibe_agent_task_pro
title: Agent Pro: a deeper task
